fact: 1919年3月20日，协约国通过驻布达佩斯军事代表向匈牙利政府发出最后通牒（威克斯通牒），要求割让约2万平方公里领土并允许协约国部队过境；卡罗伊政府辞职。3月21日社会民主党与共产党联合宣布成立匈牙利苏维埃共和国，加尔巴伊·山多尔任主席，库恩·贝拉任外交人民委员。

sources.title: 匈牙利苏维埃共和国, 百度百科
sources.quote: 1919年3月20日,帝国主义列强通过协约国统帅部驻布达佩斯代表向匈牙利政府发出最后通牒(威克斯通牒),要求匈牙利割让约2万平方千米领土,给予协约国部队通过匈牙利的权利。...3月21日,匈牙利共产党和社会民主党联合掌权,宣布成立匈牙利苏维埃共和国。...主席由社会民主党中派加尔巴伊·山多尔(1879~1947)担任,共产党人库恩·贝拉任外交人民委员。

sources.title: U.S. Library of Congress, Hungary: Hungarian Soviet Republic (Country Studies)
sources.quote: Kun emerged from jail triumphant when the Social Democrats handed power to a government of "People's Commissars," who proclaimed the Hungarian Soviet Republic on March 21, 1919.

fact: 1919年4月16日，法国联合罗马尼亚、捷克斯洛伐克与南斯拉夫军队自北、东、南三面进攻匈牙利；5月红军反攻收复失地并进入斯洛伐克，6月在科希策建立斯洛伐克苏维埃共和国；7月协约国集中兵力反攻。

sources.title: 匈牙利苏维埃共和国, Wikiwand 中文条目
sources.quote: 1919年4月16日,法國聯合羅馬尼亞、捷克斯洛伐克、南斯拉夫等國的軍隊,從東、北、南向匈牙利發起進攻。後來匈牙利蘇維埃政府奮起反擊,不僅收復了失地,而且深入捷克斯洛伐克境內追擊干涉軍,並在捷克斯洛伐克的科希策建立了斯洛伐克蘇維埃共和國。但七月,協約國集中了優勢兵力向匈牙利反攻

sources.title: 匈牙利苏维埃共和国, 百度百科
sources.quote: 4月16日,捷克斯洛伐克、罗马尼亚和法国军队从北、东、南三面向匈牙利发动进攻。5月初,侵略军进抵离布达佩斯100千米的地区,共和国危在旦夕。...5月中旬,红军发起反攻,收复大片领土。

fact: 1919年7月30日罗马尼亚军队突破匈牙利红军防线，8月1日苏维埃政府辞职，8月4日罗马尼亚军队占领并劫掠布达佩斯。

sources.title: U.S. Library of Congress, Hungary: Hungarian Soviet Republic (Country Studies)
sources.quote: Kun then unsuccessfully turned the Hungarian Red Army on the Romanians, who broke through Hungarian lines on July 30, occupied and looted Budapest, and ousted Kun's Soviet Republic on August 1, 1919.

sources.title: History of Hungary, Wikiwand 条目
sources.quote: This time, Romania marched on Budapest, occupying it on 4 August 1919. Seeing resistance as futile, the Communists resigned from power on the first of August.

fact: 1919年8月6日，右翼“白宫同志协会”领导人弗里德里希在罗马尼亚军队支持下发动不流血政变，推翻佩德尔政府；11月16日，霍尔蒂率国民军进入布达佩斯。

sources.title: Hungarian Republic (1919-1920), Wikiwand 条目
sources.quote: On 6 August 1919 István Friedrich, leader of the White House Comrades Association (a right-wing, counter-revolutionary group), ousted the government of Gyula Peidl and seized power in a bloodless coup with the backing of the Royal Romanian Army.

sources.title: History of Hungary, Wikiwand 条目
sources.quote: On 16 November 1919, as Romanian forces withdrew, the National Army of Miklós Horthy marched into Budapest.

fact: 1919年6月25日，库恩政府宣布实行无产阶级专政，将工业与商业企业、住房、交通、银行、医疗与文化机构收归社会化，并没收超过40.5公顷的土地；另有来源把土地上限记为100霍尔特、时间记为4月，两说并存。

sources.title: U.S. Library of Congress, Hungary: Hungarian Soviet Republic (Country Studies)
sources.quote: On June 25, Kun's government proclaimed a dictatorship of the proletariat, nationalized industrial and commercial enterprises, and socialized housing, transport, banking, medicine, cultural institutions, and all landholdings of more than 40.5 hectares.

sources.title: 匈牙利苏维埃共和国, 百度百科
sources.quote: 宣布将雇佣20个工人以上的工矿企业、交通运输业和商业收归国有。规定凡面积超过100霍尔特的地产一律收归国有,成立生产合作社。

fact: 1919年3月上台的苏维埃政府利用手中的奥匈银行印版大量印制小面额纸币，并另印自制大面额钞票，造成严重通胀；奥匈银行纸币直到1920年3月才加盖国别戳记，匈牙利到1921年5月才引入独立国家货币。

sources.title: Ludwig von Mises Institute, Selected Writings Vol. 2: Between the Two World Wars (chapter on monetary disorder)
sources.quote: In March 1919, a Bolshevik government took power in Budapest and began printing huge quantities of small-denomination notes with Austro-Hungarian Bank plates in their possession, as well as larger notes of their own design, causing a severe inflation. ... The Austrian Bank notes were not embossed with a national stamp until March 1920, and a separate national currency was introduced in Hungary in May 1921.

fact: 匈牙利月通胀率在战时约为2%至3%，到1919年升至约30%。

sources.title: Magyar Nemzeti Bank, Financial and Economic Review / Inflation in History (conference report)
sources.quote: Monthly inflation during the war still “only” amounted to 2–3 per cent. By 1919 the figure was 30 per cent.

fact: 1919年9月的布达佩斯，白面粉每公斤20克朗、牛肉80克朗、猪肉85克朗、香肠每公斤300至400克朗、鸡蛋每个28克朗；里兹饭店一顿简餐95克朗，多数餐馆停业，面包在市场上买不到，燃料以每公斤1克朗的木柴代替煤。

sources.title: The Czechoslovak Review, vol. 3, no. 11 (1919), 'Budapest in September'（Wikisource）
sources.quote: A kilogram of white flour costs 20 crowns ... A kilogram of beef costs 80 crowns, of veal 70, pork 85. ... a kilo of sausages from 300 to 400 ... an egg is sold for 28 crowns ... We dined at the Ritz Hotel. ... that cost 95 crowns ... bread cannot be obtained at all. ... heating is done by wood which is sold at a crown per kilogram.

fact: 1919年8月苏维埃共和国覆灭后，反共军官与罗马尼亚军队发动“白色恐怖”，对共产党人、社会党人、左翼知识分子、犹太人及卡罗伊与库恩政权的同情者进行监禁、酷刑与不经审判的处决；估计约5000人被处决、约7.5万人被监禁，近10万人被迫离境。

sources.title: Hungarian Republic (1919-1920), Wikiwand 条目
sources.quote: A "White Terror" ensued that led to the imprisonment, torture, and execution without trial of communists, socialists, Jews, leftist intellectuals, sympathizers with the Károlyi and Kun regimes ... Estimates placed the number of executions at approximately 5,000. In addition, about 75,000 people were jailed. ... the White Terror forced nearly 100,000 people to leave the country, most of them socialists, intellectuals, and middle-class Jews.

fact: 1919年9月的布达佩斯全部工厂停工：既无原料也无煤，部分机器设备已被罗马尼亚军队拆走，仅少数面粉厂在严格监管下开工。

sources.title: The Czechoslovak Review, vol. 3, no. 11 (1919), 'Budapest in September'（Wikisource）
sources.quote: All the factories in Budapest are idle; they have neither raw material nor coal nor even machinery. The Roumanians grabbed everything that could be moved. ... Only a few flour mills are grinding grain
